description: Array interface for structural element nodes.

functions.name: acc_global
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the acceleration of structure node expressed in a global coordinate system.

functions.name: acc_local
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the acceleration of structure node expressed in a local coordinate system.

functions.name: apply
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the translational and rotational applied force of the structure node expressed in the global coordinate system.

functions.name: apply_local
functions.description: Get whether the coordinate system in which generalizedapplied forces are expressed is a local system.

functions.name: component_id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the node component id.

functions.name: convergence
functions.description: Returns a NumPy array of the node convergence value, defined as the ratio of the currenct local force ratio (given by the \(ratio\) method), to the target force ratio (\(ratio.target\)). A value of 1 or less is therefore considered “converged”.

functions.name: damp_local
functions.description: Get the local damping factor of the structure nodes.

functions.name: disp_global
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the displacement of structure node expressed in a global system.

functions.name: disp_local
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the displacement of structure node expressed in a local system.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.nodearray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{node} or float{node,3}
functions.description: Get the node extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: fix
functions.description: Get velocity-fixity flag expressed in the node-local system.Return values {1, 2, 3} denotes free, fixed, or slaved to target velocity, respectively.Slaved conditions arise from rigid attachment conditions; degrees-of-freedom that are slaved cannot be fixed.

functions.name: fix_local
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the boolean flag for the local coordinate system fixity. True for fixed node-local system, False for free node-local system.

functions.name: force_unbal_global
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the unbalanced force of structure node expressed in a global system.

functions.name: force_unbal_local
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the unbalanced force of structure node expressed in a local system.

functions.name: ids
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the node structural element id.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return node group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: links
functions.signature: itasca.structure.nodearray.links() -> array of Link objets ID
functions.description: Get the link objects associated with nodes.

functions.name: local_system
functions.description: Get the local coordinate system of the structure node.

functions.name: mark
functions.description: Get the mark flag. Note that the SEL logic may modify this flag during command processing, cycling, and plotting.

functions.name: mass_added
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the extra mass in addition to the inertial mass at each degree-of-freedom in the node-local system.

functions.name: mass_local
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the mass at each degree-of-freedom in the node-local system.

functions.name: pos
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current position of structural element nodes.

functions.name: pos_reference
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the reference position of structural element nodes.

functions.name: ratio
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the local gridpoint mechanical convergence ratio. This is the ratio of unbalanced force to force applied to the node.

functions.name: ratio_target
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the target mechanical force ratio in the node. The default value is 1e-4. A local force ratio (see the \(ratio\) method) below this value is considered converged. See also the \(convergence\) method.

functions.name: resultant
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of stress resultants (Mx, My, Mxy, Nx, Ny, Nxy) last calculated for the elements connected to nodes. Note that the \(Q_x\) and \(Q_{y1}\) terms are not valid at nodes because they are constant over an element. Stress resultants are expressed in the node surface system; see the structure shell recover surface, structure geogrid recover surface, and structure liner recover surface commands.

functions.name: set_apply
functions.description: Set a component of the translational and rotational applied force of the structure node expressed in the global coordinate system. Components 0, 1, and 2 are translational and 3,4 and 5 are rotational.

functions.name: set_damp_local
functions.description: Set the local damping factor of the structure nodes.

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.nodearray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{node} or float{node, 3}) -> None
functions.description: Set the node extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: set_fix_local
functions.description: Set the boolean flag for the local coordinate system fixity. True for fixed node-local system, False for free node-local system.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.structure.nodearray.set_group(membership: array bool{node}, group_name: str, slot=1) -> None
functions.description: Set node group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding node to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

functions.name: set_mark
functions.description: Set the mark flag. Note that the SEL logic may modify this flag during command processing, cycling, and plotting.

functions.name: set_mass_added
functions.signature: itasca.structure.nodearray.set_mass_added(comp: int, mass: float) -> array (translational: vec3, rotational: vec3){node}
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the extra mass in addition to the inertial mass at each degree-of-freedom in the node-local system.

functions.name: set_ratio_target
functions.description: Set the target mechanical force ratio in the node. The default value is 1e-4. A local force ratio (see the \(ratio\) method) below this value is considered converged. See also the \(convergence\) method.

functions.name: set_surface_xdir
functions.description: Set the orientation of the surface system. surface system of the node such that the x-direction is aligned with the projection of the surface vector v onto the normal plane, which is defined by the z-direction. This operation can only be performed upon nodes that have a valid surface system (to ensure that the z-direction always corresponds with the average normal direction of at least one of the shell-type SELs using the node). A return value of \(True\) indicates success and \(False\) indicates failure.

functions.name: set_temp_increment
functions.description: Set the the temperature increment that will be applied to the structural node in the next timestep, causing elements connected to it to see changes in stress due to thermal expansion. This value is cleared to zero after every step when thermal expansion stresses are applied.

functions.name: stiff_local
functions.description: Get the stiffness of structure node expressed in a local system.A length 6 tuple is returned. The translational stiffnesses are first followed by the rotational stiffnesses.

functions.name: surface_system
functions.description: Get the surface coordinate system of the structure node.

functions.name: surface_valid
functions.description: Get a boolean flag for surface system validity; \(True\) if the surface system is valid, \(False\) if not. The surface system can be made valid by issuing a structure recovery command.

functions.name: temp_increment
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the the temperature increment that will be applied to the structural node in the next timestep, causing elements connected to it to see changes in stress due to thermal expansion. This value is cleared to zero after every step when thermal expansion stresses are applied.

functions.name: vel_global
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the velocity of a structure node expressed in a global system.

functions.name: vel_local
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the velocity of a structure node expressed in a local system.
